subject: POC timeline & kickoff - Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline & kickoff - Acme Industries

Hi Sara / Tom —

Great to meet with you this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed plan for the POC/trial so we can lock dates and owners: 

Goals / success criteria (as discussed):
- Validate Redwood inference reduces mean latency for 95th percentile inference by >= 40% vs current baseline for your daily batch, while keeping output quality parity on our evaluation prompts.
- Demonstrate cost per 1k tokens reduction via batching/quantization recommendations (target >= 30% savings).
- Confirm integration points for inference routing and SSO audit logs.

Proposed evaluation plan & timeline:
- Pre-kickoff (this week): share environment details, sample prompts, and baseline metrics.
- Kickoff: Week of May 25 — 60–90 minute technical + success criteria alignment.
- Week 1–3: Trial run with weekly check-ins (30 minutes) — integration + performance tuning.
- Final readout: week of June 14 — results, recommendations, and next steps.

Owners:
- Customer PM/exec sponsor: Sara Lin (Acme)
- Customer Eng: Tom Reyes (Acme)
- Redwood AE: Marissa Cole — coordination, commercial
- Redwood Solutions Eng: Dev Patel — technical lead
- Redwood CS: Neha Kapoor — success metrics, enablement

Action items / next steps:
1) Sara/Tom: confirm kickoff date (proposed Tue May 25 or Wed May 26) and who will join the kickoff.
2) Acme: share sample prompts, baseline p95 latency & cost metric, and VPN/ingress details if required.
3) Redwood: share POC scope doc and pre-kickoff checklist (link below).

Shared doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcmePOC

If that looks good I’ll send a calendar invite for kickoff and the weekly check-ins cadence.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & kickoff - Acme Industries

Thanks Marissa — this is great and aligns with what we discussed. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Kickoff: Tue May 25 works best for us at 10:00am PT. Will plan for 60–75 minutes (technical + success criteria).
- Attendees: myself (PM), Tom (eng lead), Maya Chen (data scientist, maya.chen@acme.com), and Brad Wong (security).
- Success criteria tweak: in addition to latency, we want to verify that the Redwood integration can serve our conversational workloads with context windows up to 12k tokens without degradation in p95 latency beyond the 40% improvement target.

We’ll upload sample prompts and baseline metrics to the shared drive by end of day Friday. For environment access: Tom will follow up with a short list of VPN details and whether a temporary service account is needed.

Please send the invite and any pre-kickoff checklist we should review.

Best,
Sara
Senior Product Manager, Acme Industries

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@acme.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & kickoff - Acme Industries

Perfect — thanks for the fast turn. Per Sara’s note I’ve updated the success criteria to include 12k context verification. Dev/Neha / Dylan — looping you in for technical prep and weekly check-ins.

I’ll send a calendar invite for Tue May 25, 10:00am PT (60–75m). Agenda for kickoff (high level):
- Introductions & roles (10m)
- Success criteria & evaluation plan walk-through (15m)
- Technical architecture & access (20m)
- Initial baseline review & immediate next tasks (15m)
- Q&A / logistics for weekly checks (10m)

Pre-kickoff ask for Acme (to upload before EOD Fri):
- Sample prompts and evaluation prompt set
- Baseline p95 / p99 latency numbers and current hardware footprint
- Representative traffic profile (peak RPS, batch sizes)
- Any compliance/security gating items (Brad)

I’ve added the kickoff agenda and an initial POC scope doc to the shared Drive (link below). If you need an NDA or security questionnaire completed ahead of kickoff, say the word and we’ll prioritize.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cAcmePOC
POC scope doc: POC-Scope-Acme-ACME-4392.pdf

I’ll follow up with the calendar invite & weekly cadence after Tom confirms the attendee list.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC timeline & kickoff - Acme Industries

Hi Tom / Marissa —

Quick technical pre-kickoff checklist from my side so we can hit the ground running on Tue: 
- Access: temporary service account + IP allowlist OR VPN credentials (please advise which is easier for your infra).
- Data: sample prompts + one representative payload (JSON) and expected output format.
- Baseline: row-level p95/p99 exports (CSV) with timestamps and request sizes.
- Hardware: current inference fleet spec (GPU type / memory) and avg batch sizes.
- Security: any required SCIM/SSO setup or audit log endpoints.

I’ve attached a short infra checklist as a stub — infra-checklist.pdf — to give you an idea of what we’ll need. If you can share the requested items to the Drive before EOD Fri, we’ll pre-populate a tuning run and have initial metrics to look at in the kickoff.

Thanks —
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
dev_patel@redwood.ai
Attachment: infra-checklist.pdf (1 page)

From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acme.com>

Marissa / team —

Confirmed: Kickoff Tue May 25, 10:00am PT (I’ll send the calendar invite to include Maya and Brad). We’ve uploaded sample prompts, baseline exports, and our fleet specs to the Drive.

A few notes:
- We’ll provide a temporary service account and IP allowlist (security will follow up with the CIDR list).
- Maya will own the evaluation prompts and will be our point for the final readout metrics.
- Brad will validate any audit/log requirements during kickoff.

Looking forward to the kickoff — please send the calendar invite and any final pre-kickoff items you need.

Tom Reyes
Engineering Lead, Acme Industries
